result.description: Email marketing platform: audiences, campaigns, automations, templates, reports via Marketing API.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 authorization-code flow (login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/authorize + /oauth2/token) with non-expiring access tokens, no refresh token, for multi-account apps; API key for own account.
result.access_detail: Anyone can create an API key in account or register an OAuth app (client_id/secret) from Registered Apps. Docs reviewed do not state plan restriction on API; free plan availability not confirmed on pages read.
result.api_notes: Marketing API v3.0 at https://api.mailchimp.com/3.0/ covers lists/audiences, members, campaigns, automations, templates, reports, etc. Separate Transactional API exists. Official SDKs.

evidence.quote: Mailchimp implements the standard authorization code flow
An API key authenticates requests against your own Mailchimp account.
Mailchimp access tokens have no expiry, so there is no refresh_token
This searches documentation, not your Mailchimp account.
